Wishful Thinking is an upcoming romantic comedy film written by and directed by Graham Parkes and starring Maya Hawke and Lewis Pullman.
Cast
* Maya Hawke
* Lewis Pullman
Production
The film is written and directed by Graham Parkes. It is produced by Highway 10, Buckwild and Pinky Promise with Matt Smith and Dan Gedman producing for Highway 10, Lewis Pullman producing for his company Buckwild, and Kara Durrett for Pinky Promise. Pullman also leads the cast, with Maya Hawke.
Filming locations include Portland, Oregon.
